node: HBM stack process and advanced-packaging workflow: die thinning, vertical interconnects, bonding, underfill, inspection, and co-packaging with accelerators
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the HBM stack and advanced-packaging workflow node. The strongest direct public-market mappings in this pass are not HBM producers, but inspection/metrology, wafer-level test, and OSAT/advanced-packaging capacity providers. The underfollowed lane is led by Camtek, Onto Innovation, and FormFactor because their exposure sits closer to yield-control and test-intensity bottlenecks than broad semiconductor equipment leaders. Amkor is included as an obvious reference/context anchor for outsourced advanced-packaging capacity, but its direct HBM-stack exposure requires separation from broader 2.5D/CoWoS-style packaging exposure.
